opening.argument: The video presents a desktop cryptocurrency arbitrage tool and demonstrates how it is configured and used. The speaker identifies it as “a crypto arbitrage robot,” describes selecting base and other currencies, setting a minimum percentage, and checking for opportunities, while the visible application shows orange check controls and a populated results table. The description provides an “Official Site” download link and explains that the video shows how to “download and install desktop app.” The speaker also reports using the tool “for the past week... ...with success.” These facts describe a software product and its interface, but they do not establish a fraudulent deposit request or a guaranteed profit offer.
